scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) And Research Associateship (RA) For Foreign Nationals
other_conditions: Eligible candidates are students and teachers from developing countries of Asia, Africa, and Latin America.
For Junior Research Fellowship (JRF), male candidates must be 35 years or younger and female candidates must be 40 years or younger as of 1 July of the application year.
For Research Associateship (RA), male candidates must be 40 years or younger and female candidates must be 45 years or younger as of 1 July of the application year.
JRF applicants must possess a high‑class master’s degree with a second‑class bachelor’s degree, or a second‑class master’s degree with a first‑class bachelor’s degree.
RA applicants must hold a doctorate degree, have published research work, and provide evidence of independent research work.
benefits_summary: JRF fellows receive a monthly fellowship of Rs 12,000–14,000 (plus contingent allowances) for up to four years; RA fellows receive a fixed monthly fellowship of Rs 16,000 for four years.
